entries.zh: 把总，明清军队统兵的低级武官
entries.en: sargento mayor: sergeant major, a Spanish military field-officer rank

entries.zh: 游击，明代武职官名（游击将军）
entries.en: youji, a Ming military field-commander rank; second equivalent listed under sargento mayor
sarmiento: vine shoot, vine branch; rattan, vine

entries.zh: 疥，疥疮；亦指家畜的疥癣
疥癣，疥与癣类的皮肤疾患
entries.en: scabies and ringworm; itching skin disease
sarna gruesa: thick scab, crusted itch; scabby sore
entries.notes: L 栏尾词 Haga 无从解释（疑为讹字或他语残迹），释义据汉字疥瘡与 sarna gruesa 互证；R 栏空白。
汉字「泖」有[疑]（泖/㾖）疑非本字，zh 依西语 sarpullido（发疹）与闽南音写 pui 推断为痱类皮疹；R 栏残缺。

entries.en: small rash pimple, prickly heat; diminutive of sarpullido
entries.notes: 同条汉字存疑（泖仔），词尾为小称；整词被圈出，或系勾选/更正标记。

entries.en: sarta: string, skein; also used as a numeral classifier
strung together in strings, like beads of a rosary

entries.zh: 偿付，还清；使满足（字「优」与西语义合存疑）
entries.en: satisfacer, satisfecho: to satisfy, to pay (a debt); satisfied
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅「優」一字，与 satisfacer 义合不密；闽南音写栏残损且混入同栏西班牙文注（tiene lof amenester bona uita），R 栏残缺。

entries.en: to cease, stop; settled, concluded (mapped under satisfecho)
entries.notes: 「休」对 satisfecho 取「了结、停当」义系推断；R 栏空白。
「慊」兼『不满足』与『满足』两读两义，据西语 harto（餍足）取满足义；闽南音写栏有污损。

entries.en: pleased and satisfied; content and sated
